messages:
Eric: Quick sync — we need final signoff on the GA readiness checklist for the pilot -> GA cut. Focus: SLA text, customer docs, support coverage, monitoring/runbooks, pricing addendum. Who can take each?

Gina: I can take SLA drafting. Question: do we standardize a hosted vs dedicated SLO or split by commercial tier?

Eric: Split by tier. Draft targets: hosted standard = 99.9% monthly uptime; p95 latency target 500ms for typical short requests. Dedicated/Committed = 99.95% uptime; p95 250ms for expected seq lengths. Also include degradation policy (automatic fallback to compatible model variant + region failover + customer notification).

Sam: Sounds good. I'll own alerts/runbooks/escalation steps. Proposing alert triggers: error-rate >0.5% sustained over 5m, latency p95 >2x SLO for 10m, and circuit-breaker on >5% tail errors. I'll include mitigation playbook (route to standby region, degrade to smaller model, throttle non-critical batches).

Maria: I'll own pilot customer comms and agreement addendum. Need SLA wording + finance on pilot discounts + legal on credits cap. Also clarify support coverage: are pilots covered by 24x7 oncall or business-hours SE support?

Kevin: I'll produce the customer-facing quickstart and an ops-facing rollout runbook. Draft doc paths I plan to add: 
```
/docs/pilot/onboarding.md
/docs/pilot/expected-behavior-and-limits.md
/docs/ops/runbooks/pilot-rollout.md
/docs/ops/playbooks/region-failover.md
```
Will wire in the SLA blurb once Gina posts it.

Gina: Draft SLA snippet (will post PR EOD). Rough copy to review: 
```
SLOs:
- Hosted (Standard): 99.9% monthly availability. Latency: p95 <= 500ms for requests <=512 tokens.
- Dedicated (Committed): 99.95% monthly availability. Latency: p95 <= 250ms for typical request patterns.
Credits: Service credits up to a capped amount for qualifying breaches; see commercial addendum.
```
Note: need input from legal on caps & dispute resolution.

Anne: Legal will review credits clause. We prefer explicit cap (e.g., max 3 months of fees prorated) and a clear remedies section. I can turn around comments within 48 hours if finance signs off on pricing language.

Lily: Finance: pilot discount approved up to 30% for selected accounts. Overage billing monthly in arrears; set billing alert at 80% of committed capacity. Will send the formal note to Maria.

Sam: Runbook outline I'm planning to include: incident triage checklist, roles (SE, oncall, infra), severity definitions aligned with SLOs, automated mitigations (route to standby region, model-variant fallback), test playbook for DR. ETA for first draft: tomorrow 09:00 PT.

Maria: For customers: I want a one-page onboarding + FAQ that covers SLAs, credits, expected performance, and escalation contacts. Also a short sales blurb that the AE team can paste. Kevin, can you template that snippet for copy/paste?

Kevin: Yep — will include a short sales-ready paragraph and a technical appendix for SEs. Also will add a checklist for pilot acceptance criteria (smoke tests, latency/throughput baselines, security review).

Eric: Action owners recap: Gina = SLA text & contract blurb, Sam = alerts/runbooks & escalation steps, Kevin = docs/quickstart + sales snippet, Maria = pilot comms + customer onboarding, Lily = finance pricing confirmation, Anne = legal review. Let's lock ETA: SLA PR by EOD, runbook draft tomorrow morning, docs + sales snippet tomorrow afternoon, legal comments in 48h.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/feature-flag-pilot -> canary at 2024-11-15T22:00Z (automated).

Sam: One more operational ask — we should add synthetic checks for p50/p95/p99 per region and a daily health dashboard. I'll add dashboard panels to the shared console dashboard and include alert links in the runbook.

Gina: I'll include an explicit "supported features" table in the SLA appendix (streaming, embeddings, function calls, structured outputs) and call out which are in-scope for credits.

Maria: Looping in @Lily and @Anne on the thread for visibility. Also recommending we include a short "what we don't cover in pilot" list to set expectations.

Eric: Great. Final ask — everyone please drop status on your PRs/notes in this thread once posted. I'll compile into a single GA readiness doc for the leadership review by Fri EOD.

release-bot: note: rollback window enabled for canary until 2024-11-16T02:00Z.
